bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
owner="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
test -n "$owner" || exit 62
latest="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$owner" -d videobot -Atc "SELECT phase FROM videobot_sticker_registration_receipts WHERE phase<>'registered' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1")" || exit 63
case "$latest" in needs_reconcile)exit 80;;submission_started)exit 81;;preparing)exit 82;;uploaded)exit 83;;'')exit 0;;*)exit 84;;esac
